question: What do the Skydio X10 and the DJI Matrice 30T do when the link is lost?

intake.reason: Query about DJI Matrice 30T lost-link guidance from manuals

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance indicates that when a loss of control link occurs, you should try to reestablish the control link, and if unable to reestablish, start emergency or contingency procedures and discontinue flight until the control link is inspected; preflight briefings must include control link loss procedures; two or more certificated remote pilots may transfer control only if both can maintain VLOS without LOC.

claims.text: When a loss of control link occurs, FAA advises: 'Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.'
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
claims.quote: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.

claims.text: The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.
claims.quote: The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.

claims.text: Two or more certificated remote pilots transferring operational control may do so only if they are both capable of maintaining Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) of the small unmanned aircraft without loss of control (LOC).
claims.quote: they are both capable of maintaining Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) of the small unmanned aircraft without loss of control (LOC)
conditions: both capable of maintaining VLOS without LOC

claims.text: When the remote controller signal is lost, the action can be set to RTH, land, or hover.
claims.quote: action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover

claims.text: If the action is set to RTH, Failsafe RTH automatically activates after the remote controller signal is lost for more than six seconds.
claims.quote: Failsafe RTH automatically activates after the remote controller signal is lost for more than six seconds

claims.text: If lighting is sufficient and the vision systems are working, DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the remote controller signal was lost.
claims.quote: DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the remote controller signal was lost

claims.text: When the lighting is not sufficient and the vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH.
claims.quote: When the lighting is not sufficient and the vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH

claims.text: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored.
claims.quote: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored

claims.text: The reporter states "went into a lost link and returned home within 10 seconds of the glitching screen. UAS RTH at programmed altitude without issue."
claims.quote: went into a lost link and returned home within 10 seconds of the glitching screen. UAS RTH at programmed altitude without issue.

claims.text: The reporter states "Lost link and RTH occurred twice on back-to-back hops."
claims.quote: Lost link and RTH occurred twice on back-to-back hops.
conditions: two UAS were in the area (approx 500 feet apart)

claims.text: The reporter states "Repeated testing shows interference with the flight controller within 5 feet of the antenna."
claims.quote: Repeated testing shows interference with the flight controller within 5 feet of the antenna.
conditions: cellular antenna booster within 6 feet of the pilot in command

claims.text: In a separate report, the user described loss of control with the drone and attempted RTH and ATTI modes without success before control was regained and the drone landed.
claims.quote: I was operating a DJI M30T and had just taken off at a beach location when at around 25' AGL the drone decided to take off vertically and I lost all control of the drone.

gaps.text: DJI Matrice 30T resumes RTH/land/hover after loss vs FAA guidance to discontinue flight and reestablish control.
RTH path display when lighting is sufficient vs incident reports showing RTH during loss of link.
RTH remains active after RC signal restoration vs FAA guidance to reestablish link and resume control.
Skydio is not in the approved collection, so the brief does not cover it.
Missing evidence in official docs on RTH behavior when vision systems fail or lighting is insufficient.
Interference near the antenna reported; unclear how this affects RTH behavior in official docs.

removed_claims.text: A forum post notes that the aircraft entered return to home without warning, with live video remaining and stick inputs ineffective before landing at its home point.
removed_claims.quote: Without warning the aircraft entered return to home.
